Tashnagi Hoton Pe Le Kar Chal Diye Asghar Maidaan

Maa Ko Ab Tak Yaad Hai, Khushk Hai Uski Zubaan

Godh e Madar Se Liya, Haathon Pe Jab Shabbir Ne

Saamne Hurmal Ke Jaa, Ke Yeh Kaha Beysheer Ne

Torh Doon Ga Has Ke Baba, Aise Zaalim Ki Kamaan

Hurmala Ke Teer Ne, Sookhi Zubaan Ko Tarr Kiya

Haq Risalat Ka Adaa, Yun Kalmago Ne Kar Diya

Baba Ke Haathon Pe Lee Hain, Pyaase Ne Chund Hichkiyaan

Khaymey Mai Baba Mera, Lasha Na Le Kar Jaaiye

Maa Pareshaan Hogi Mer,i Unko Na Kuch Batlaaiye

Aapke Chehre Se Khoon Ke, Dekhlayngi Khud Nishaan

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/tashnagi-hoton-pe-le-kar-chal-diye-nw-beb19cdb14cd.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in edition.splitlines()).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(blocks[0]), *(len(block)-1 for block in blocks[1:])] == [2, 3, 3, 3]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 11 verses per edition across the opening and three matching stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script body and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions contain 11 verses across a two-verse opening and three numbered stanzas.

Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, kept the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed `noUrdu`. Preserved the distinct readings `Hurmal` and `Hurmala` as حرمل and حرملہ, and corrected the stray comma in `Mer,i`. Only the selected lyric was edited.
